ICS 65.150TXD 18Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies a method for the determination of mesh length of fishing nets. It is applicable to the fishing nets which are used in passive as well as active fishing gears.2. REFERENCESThe standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
